title: hilvan learner model, format 1
description: Everything hilvan knows about one learner: each card with every answer behind it, the learner's own words, the voices they chose and the answers of the inventory. Material - packs, the lexicon - is not in it; everything keys on what outlives a reload of a pack: a formula's id, a word's lemma, a sentence's text. Written by `hilvan export` and GET /api/model, read by `hilvan import`.

$schema.description: The schema the file follows: this one.

format.description: The version of the file's shape. A change that would break a reader of this format is a new one.

as_of.description: The moment the model is told as of: when it was written, or an earlier one for a snapshot - the answers given by then, played through the scheduler again.

languages.description: The languages the learner has to do with. Every language named elsewhere in the file is listed here.

native.description: Whether it is the learner's own language. At most one is.

packs.description: The packs the learner was learning from, and their versions. A reader that has other versions loaded can still read the model: cards key on ids, not on rows.

cards.description: Every card that has been answered. A card never answered is new and carries nothing of the learner; a loaded pack makes those.

anchors.description: The one sentence each word is heard in, fixed by its first answer. A sentence no loaded pack shows any more is dropped on import, and the word is heard in the first sentence it is met in until it is answered again.

own_words.description: Nouns and verbs from the learner's own life, substituted into the slots of the drill that take them.

language.description: The language being learnt that the word is of.

native.description: What it means, in the learner's own language.

target.description: As it is said in a sentence: "a car", "swim".

voices.description: The voice the learner chose for a language, where they chose one. A snapshot carries the voices chosen when it was written: a choice keeps no date.

voice.description: The engine's own id of the voice.

inventory.description: Every answer of the inventory, either way: the commonest words of the language, each asked once - do you know it? A yes is also a declared review on the word's card.

word.description: A word of a language: its code and its lemma, lowercase - en:house, en:i.

card.description: One card: what it schedules, where it stands, and the answers that put it there. Its state is what its answers leave when played through FSRS in order; the fields are kept so a reader need not replay to know it.

kind.description: formula: saying a formula, prompted in the learner's own language. formula-recognise: understanding it, prompted in the language being learnt. word: a word, asked in a sentence.

subject.description: A formula's id, or a word: en:house.

state.description: basted: answered, still loose. sewn: holding over long intervals. A card with answers is never new.

stability.description: FSRS: days until recall is predicted to fall to 90%.

difficulty.description: FSRS: how hard the card is for this learner, 1 to 10.

lapses.description: How many times it was forgotten once sewn.

review.description: One answer, and the card as it left it.

source.description: asked: the tutor asked and the learner answered. declared: the learner said they know it unasked - the inventory - which moves the card as an easy would and is not counted as an answer.

elapsed_days.description: Days since the answer before, as FSRS counted them.

duration_ms.description: How long the answer took, when the app measured it.

attempts.description: The turns typed for the answer, in order; empty for one that was not typed.

attempt.description: One typed turn, as the server read it.

prompt.description: What the learner read, in their own language.

expected.description: The right answer closest to what was typed.

typed.description: What the learner typed, as typed.

failure.description: formula: the formula's own pieces did not come. order: every word came, in the wrong order. word: the shape came, a word it carries did not. Null when the turn was right.

missed.description: The words of the answer that did not come.
